profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NetApp
profile.geoLocationName: Wake Forest, North Carolina, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
DISTRIBUTED SYSTEMS & CORE KERNEL LEADERSHIP
Technical Lead for Kernel Cluster Services, owning the architecture of critical distributed system components.
Developed and maintained a high-performance distributed cluster transaction manager providing consensus functionality across complex multinode environments.
Engineered and supported critical cluster services including automated health monitoring, a simplified resilient network connection manager, distributed versioning, and cluster-wide timers.
Acted as a cross-functional technical advisor to internal client teams, analyzing workflows and providing guidance on optimal service utilization.

SAN & PERFORMANCE ENGINEERING
Developed kernel components to support SAN in Ontap clustered storage OS architecture.
Engineered Ontap SAN support for remote I/O and implemented filesystem logic for SAN-specific operations, including metadata and cancel operations.
Served as the global performance owner for SAN protocols, driving optimization across FCP, SCSI Target, and NVMe over Fabrics (NVMe-oF) by redesigning core data structures and multithreaded algorithms to maximize concurrency and scaling from virtualized cloud deployments to flagship enterprise hardware.

NEXT-GEN NETWORKING & RDMA INTEGRATION
Partnered cross-functionally with the networking engineering group to design and integrate RDMA utilizing RoCEv2 into the cluster interconnect.
Leveraged the OFED framework to implement multi-technology RDMA support, optimizing network performance and reducing resource utilization.
Architected systems to scale performance seamlessly across the entire product portfolio, ranging from entry-level virtual cloud based deployments up to top-tier enterprise hardware systems.

CUSTOMER & ESCALATION ENGINEERING
Directly engaged with high-profile customer accounts to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex distributed systems and performance bugs in production environments.
positions.insights: Distributed Systems, Storage Area Networks and +7 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Systems Software Engineer with a diverse background in C programming, Linux systems development, and telecom infrastructures. During my tenure at Cisco, I focused on high-performance routing architectures and software-hardware integration. My key contributions included developing core features for the Cisco IOS platform, managing the software packaging and system deployment for Linux-based mezzanine cards, and engineering software for multi-processor routing blades supporting mobile wireless networks (PDSN/GGSN). Additionally, I worked on SS7/IP convergence projects, where I wrote the IOS integration layers and modified the underlying firmware to enable hardware offload functionality on specialized E1/T1 telecom cards.

Received a Cisco Pioneer Award.
positions.insights: Software Design, Embedded Linux and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical Lead and Systems Software Engineer for telecom services for SS7 networks. Served as the tech lead for the Local Toll-Free (LTF / 800-service) application deployed on the SCP platform, driving the project from initial requirement definitions through architectural design and development. Recognized with an Outstanding Performance Award for leadership and engineering excellence in delivering high-availability telecom infrastructure.
